# C04 — Formal Limit

## #0

A formal limit is generated by an operation's own structure. The operation can succeed, become more exact and admit more information while reproducing the boundary in question. In the essay's primary case, representing the conditions of representation produces a further representation. The act now making it has not become identical with its represented content.

A [determination](C03-Determination.md) achieves a mark under conditions which give that mark its sense. Including those conditions can make the mark more exact and its use more answerable. The [recurrent act/content difference](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) arises through that very inclusion: the enlarged account has become a further determination. Inquiry distinguishes what it can supply from what its present supplying enacts again.

## #1

Attempt the inclusion. Name the language, instrument, prior distinctions and position through which an account was made. Each can become more legible. Now include the act of making that enlarged account. It too becomes something represented, while the present act of representing continues. The new account genuinely knows more; it has not closed the difference between a representation and its occurrence.

Taylor gives this activity its circle image: **“every circle is a closure in, not around, the reality it designates.”** In “The Edge of the Rational,” at line13, the [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q002|defining act]] takes place within the reality it articulates. Drawing a further circle can disclose the earlier drawing; the further drawing remains an act within its situation. The philosophical image concerns this relation of inclusion to its present enactment. A geometrical line can itself be represented and drawn.

## #2

An omitted measurement and the act of measurement therefore make different demands. The omitted measurement can be supplied. Representing the act makes its conditions available without moving the present act outside all conditions. Calling both “unknown” loses the distinction on which the argument depends.

The [immutable gap](C05-Immutable-Gap.md) preserves recurrent non-coincidence through successful inquiry. An inspecting agent can know a mechanism completely under the stated description: that mechanism is its known field, and instruments, observations and comparison rules are its means. The inspecting agent occupies a local functional knower office. Within a person's containing inquiry, the apparatus itself serves as means and can become known in a further inspection. The current first-person apprehension remains active through this disclosure. Greater knowledge of the means strengthens their accountable use while renewing the relation in which they are known.

Taylor's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|eightfold knowing relation]] gives this limit its positive traversal. The parent `/ = −/−` makes relating available before its terms are assigned. `0/1` opens conscious circumstance as awareness and appearing phenomenon. `?/!` takes that appearance into question and assertion, each answerable through the other. `−/+` makes withdrawal and extension co-present as a pulse; `X/x` makes determining capacity legible in its recurring instance. `AM/IS` lives the relation as first-person presence, addressing You and third-person sayability within circumstance. `∞/dx` gives local difference exactness within an inexhaustible horizon. `1/0` returns the achieved determination towards its presupposed ground through recognition. The parent and return bracket the six positions; eight operations give the relation its passage.

The crossed-zero recognition makes the means available within that passage. Its initial `0` marks unobjectifiable presence before the instrument's apparent self takes form; the later manifest return will be `0/1`. `Ø` initially fuses the instrument's slash with the apparent self; `X` differentiates an object-field through the same activity. `Ø/X` brings their mediation into view. `(0/Ø)/(1/X)` makes the subjectward and objectward recognition-relations available together; `1` affirms their integrated unity and returns to the manifest pulse `0/1`. Recognising the means preserves their real work. Its present apprehension remains different from what the recognition has made explicit.

## #3

Formal comparisons sharpen the question by preserving the operation which reaches each limit. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/russell/russell-1908-theory-types/russell-1908-theory-types#russell-1908-theory-types-q001|Russell's restriction on reflexive formation]], a totality cannot contain members defined through that totality. Relative types concern variables and their ranges of significance. Restricting formation changes which expressions are admissible and still permits valid construction. This technical response has its own work to do.

The [different continuations of a formal limit](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#limit-and-recurring-gap) retain that constructive gain beside a different proof relation. Russell's repair changes allowable formation. Gödel's incompleteness concerns derivability in a specified theory under its stated hypotheses. A calculus which admits re-entry must specify the rules of that operation. Enlarging or revising one system can achieve valid work while these operations remain distinct. The present act of enlargement also retains its difference from the content it has made available.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/godel/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions|Gödel's arithmetical incompleteness]] fixes a jurisdiction: effectively axiomatized systems sufficiently expressive for arithmetic, with the relevant consistency hypotheses. A well-formed sentence's unprovability is relative to the specified theory; adding a further assumption changes its warrant. Valid arithmetic and proof checking remain possible within that theory. The result is specific to this mathematical object and its hypotheses. The determining-act relation is established through its own performed account; a proof about arithmetical derivability supplies a distinct comparison.

A proposed comparison with [[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form|distinction and re-entry in the calculus of indications]] asks what happens when a form re-enters its own distinction. Marked and unmarked are offices of that calculus. An explicit mapping must preserve them and the rules which govern their transformations. QL's unobjectifiable condition concerns the present act through which a distinction is known. Keeping these offices distinct lets knowing and formal re-entry be compared through their declared operations, while the unmarked state retains its calculus and the present act its recognitive office.

## #4

Changing a formal container can change what is expressible. Its rules determine which operations remain valid. A new regime states the permissions it changes and the laws it retains. The [advent of arithmetic zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) makes this difference historically consequential: positional absence becomes an operand, and a retained zero denominator enters its particular regime. Ordinary field division leaves a zero denominator undefined. A historical regime can retain the expression under restricted cancellation or postponed evaluation. These permissions determine which consequences each operation can license.

[Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md) makes the mediation more transparent within its current act. A richer contextual description can expose additional conditions; seeing how those conditions participate changes the relation in which the description is used. The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD|placing relation]] remains situated while making its own situation available. The placing-act occurs through the body, language, instruments and horizon it may name. Its philosophical force concerns this situated operation; the lexical history of its terms has its own witnesses.

## #5→0

In the [eye's returning recognition](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-recognition-return), a mirror, anatomical account or another person's view can disclose a real condition of seeing. Each disclosure still occurs within a further seeing. The anatomical blind spot can become a known object; the current apprehension through which it is known has a different office. The image makes the performed limit intimate while each mathematical comparison retains its independent hypotheses.

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../../../symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) gives investigation an approachable limit and faith an absolute one. Determination is investigation's limit; faith's relation is never to be determined. The four lines hold inquiry's real achievement beside the conscious undertaking which can continue through that achievement's finitude. Giving an account and living its answerable use have distinct work to do.

A [faithful definition](C02-Faithful-Definition.md) exposes the relations through which its predicates apply and remains answerable to what they concern. A corrected answer can proceed under a fitting rule; a defective rule or commission must reach the authority able to revise it; an examined condition can be retained with reasons. The next act inherits the warranted judgment. [Trust and faith](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) carry a finite life through such undertakings without possessing their final ground. Commitment can be investigated, corrected or withdrawn; harm and refusal remain consequential to its continuation.

The [performed first-person definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) becomes faithful by returning the act of defining to the one engaged in it. Its failure of exhaustive enclosure can disclose that present relation. At the [advent of integral zero](../A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), the achieved mathematical sign retains its exact powers while returning as Symbol. The exact determination participates in a relation it cannot enclose and makes a renewed determination possible.

### Source and formal standing

Russell's selected 1908 passages concern the vicious-circle principle and relative types. Gödel's housed German fragments retain their context; an exact English translation of Satz VI and Satz XI remains a separate passage burden, and original and later refined consistency hypotheses retain their distinctions. Spencer-Brown's work is a selected formal neighbour with no excerpt yet gathered for its opening, equations or re-entry; no particular re-entry derivation or temporal interpretation is newly admitted here. The circle and eye are Taylor's authored figures, and the native performed definition retains its own philosophical warrant.
